'''Lake worms''', also known as '''sea worms''' or '''water-worms''', were giant [[Worm/Legends|worm]] creatures living on the rainswept [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], two of these creatures dwelled at the bottom of a [[mud lake]] and made trouble for the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] when they dragged the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] down to the lake's [[Water/Legends|watery]] depths. They were impervious to blaster fire, as Ackbar and his crew found out the hard way. Exactly what they did to the ships after submerging them are unknown, although Ackbar stated that they do not eat them. Ackbar later speculated that the worms attacked various ships because the sounds of engines irritated them, whether it be skimmer engines or starship engines.
